interface.description: Interface ID (`IFC-(SYNC|ASYNC)-NNNN`) once assigned -- a Stage 1 raw-pass candidate legitimately cannot know that ID yet (assigned downstream by consensus aggregation) and should instead cite the interface by name, method+path, or topic; scripts/consensus.py resolves these name-shaped references once Interfaces are ID-assigned.

confidence.description: E.g. a field that is not observably volatile in the evidence available but is conventionally a generated value (an id on a newly-created resource) should be flagged here rather than asserted as confirmed. Same convention as behavior.schema.json (REQ-09, C10).

verdict.description: REQ-05. NO-GO blocks Stage 6 for this Interface (not Stage 1).
